headline: Liberia central bank raises US dollar reserve rule to 12%, maintains rate at 16%
summary: Liberia's central bank increased the reserve requirement on US dollar deposits to 12%, kept its policy rate steady at 16%, and reported that inflation decreased to 4.5%.
why: In dual-currency economies like Liberia, foreign exchange reserve requirements directly regulate commercial bank liquidity and domestic monetary conditions.

impacts.name: Liberia
impacts.why: Tighter USD deposit reserve rules restrict bank lending capacity in foreign currency.
